annotation.title_clean: Decreto Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti 28 febbraio 2018 - Modalità attuative e strumenti operativi della sperimentazione su strada delle soluzioni di Smart Road e di guida connessa e automatica
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Decree of 28 February 2018 - Implementing Rules and Operational Tools for Road Testing of Smart Road Solutions and Connected and Automated Driving
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti (Italy)
annotation.venue: Gazzetta Ufficiale n. 90, 18/04/2018 (via Archivio Normativa LavoriPubblici.it)
annotation.summary_en: Italian ministerial decree (Delrio) establishing the Smart Road digital-infrastructure programme and the authorisation regime for public-road testing of automated and connected vehicles, including supervisor requirements, safety and cybersecurity conditions, data recording, mandatory insurance, reporting duties and a technical Observatory.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministry authorises road testing of automated vehicles; one-year renewable authorisation, vehicles registered and marked
A qualified human supervisor must be able to take control at any time and is responsible for the vehicle
Applicants must show prior test mileage, risk analysis, cybersecurity protections and 10 Hz data recording
Civil liability insurance with a ceiling at least four times that of the standard vehicle is mandatory
Incident reporting within 15 days; authorisation can be suspended or revoked; Observatory created to advise and monitor
